0022600129.text: The Knicks, who are 0-2 and 11th in the East, host the Detroit Pistons, who are 2-0, first in the Central and first in the East, and riding a two-game winning streak. Jose Alvarado is out for New York with an ankle sprain, while Detroit is without Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks lost the 2025-26 season series 0-3, most recently 126-111 in New York on February 19, 2026.
